computedFields._why: Item 5a asks what type of court papers the sheriff is serving. In this packet it is always a domestic violence restraining order - that is what SER-001 is here for - so the words are written whenever there is a person to serve. Two conditions with the same words, so either one is enough and the words appear once.

Item 5b lists the forms to serve. The packet knows them: DV-109 with DV-100, DV-110 and a blank DV-120 always (the same set DV-200 item 4a and 4b print), and each attachment exactly when the answer that brings it in was given. CLETS-001 is confidential and never served, so it is not listed. FL-150 is served with a blank FL-150 whenever the packet makes it (either support box), and RA-010 whenever the filer will attend by phone or video.

autofilledFields.why: Item 2c asks for the case name, "example: Garcia v. Smith" - the filer against the person to be restrained, both already named on DV-100 items 1 and 2.
Item 3a(3), "Date of birth or age". DV-100 item 2 asks both; the box gets the date of birth and the age, or whichever one was given.
Item 3a(3), "Vehicle (type, model, year, color, plate number)". CLETS-001 item 1 asks the type, model, year and plate; they are carried over instead of typed twice.
A signature date has one correct answer and the form already knows it.
The printed name under the signature is the name given in item 2a.
